msContents.summary: This manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya was microfilmed as part of the NGMPP project. The catalogue describes it as incomplete.

msItem.title: Itihāsasamuccaya
msItem.explicit: tām agnir varayāmāsa sākṣād adbhutadarśanāṃ | prādā

acquisition.p: Held at the National Archives, Kathmandu, Nepal.

lg.l:
kathayantaṃ hi tīrthānāṃ prabhāvān adbhutāṃs ta
thā |
romasaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ prapraccha ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||

yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇā
gataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yas syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana ||

ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvvasamagravarada¦
kṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ ||
idam eva purā devās tulayāsatolayan

prāṇarakṣaṇa
m eveha gauraveṇātiricyate ||
atraivādāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |

indrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiverājño na
rasya ca ||
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śiviṃ vṛthāṃ
indraḥ śyenaḥ kapoto 'gni bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ ||

||
athoruṃ nṛpataḥ prāpya kapotaḥ syenajād bhayāt |
saraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye bhayavihvalaḥ ||

tataḥ
śanair upāgasya syainarūpiī suresvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sa mahātmānaṃ provācadaṃ vacas tadā ||

||
dharmātmānaṃ cāhur ekaṃ sarvvarājan mahīkṣitaḥ |
satvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi katham etat kariṣyasi ||

bhavāt kṛta
ghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |
kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇām asādhu sādhunā jayat ||

nopakārapareṣv eva
m apakāparo janaḥ |
apakāre pare pi tvaṃm upakaraparo yathā ||

ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe pi tvame
pāpakṛta |
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ ||

tadeṣa vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā
|
taṃ rakṣa dharmalobheta dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi ||

satrastrarūpas trāṇārthī tvato bhīto haṃvivihaṃga
maḥ |
matsakāsam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛdhnuraya khagaḥ ||
yad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayārthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ ||
lobhād vaiṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajec charaṇāgataṃ |

brahma
hatyāsaman tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇāḥ ||
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |

śaraṇāgata
hantus tu na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā |

tasmān mṛtyubha
yatrastrās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ ||
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |

jantavaḥ pari
kliśyante mṛtyos trasyanti te tataḥ ||
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā krodha eva yā |

āyāso vā yato mūlaṃ e
kāham api na tyajet ||
maliṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate |

yuktan tenānumānena paro pi pa¦
rirakṣituṃ ||
yathā hi te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jītaṃ priye |

saṃrakṣate jīvitam ātma
no yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ ||
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |

yad atra yukta¦
m anyat te kartuṃ syenāśu tad vada ||
āhārāt sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti janeśvara |

āhāreṇa vi
varddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ ||
śakyate nyair vinā py arthai rājāan varttayituṃ ciraṃ |

na tv āhāravihīnena
śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvacit ||
bhakṣād vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viśāṃpate |

visṛjya kāṃya yāsyanti panthānam apu
narbhavaṃ ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvvaṃ me putradālaṃ mariṣyati |
rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi ||

dharmaṃ yo
bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||

tasmād virodhe dharmasya
vicintya gurulāghavaṃ |
yataḥ śreyas tato rājan kuru dharmavinirṇṇayaḥ ||

nāsmād bhūyataro
dharmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate ||

varam ekasya satvasya pradattā
bhayadakṣiṇā |
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasram alaṃkṛtam ||

abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāpa
raḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit ||
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi |

du
rllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtābhayapradaḥ
mahatā mayi yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ |

bhītābhayapra
dāsya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā śrutan tathā |

sarvvāny abhayadānasya kalāṃ nā
rhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ ||
catuḥsāgaraparyyantāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ |
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtasyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ ||

a
pi tyaje rājyam ahaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ ||

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiñci
t tena janmani janmiani |
bhaveyam aham arttānāṃ prāṇinām ārttināśanaḥ ||

na hy ahaṅ kāmaya rājyaṃ na svarggaṃ nāpunarbbhavaṃ
|
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ ||
yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛtā |

satyenānena
bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||
āhārārthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṅgama |

tad yathaiṣṭan tavāhāram anyad eva dadā
my ahaṃ ||
ya evaṃ vihito 'smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ ||

tam utsṛjya na cāhāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparai
r mama ||
syenāḥ kapotān_ khādhanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan sāram ajñātvā kadalīskandham āruha ||
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārggeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |
śāstrair evopadiṣṭo 'yaṃ¦ dharmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ ||

sarvvasatveṣu
yad dānam ekasatveṣu yā dayā |
sarvvasatvapradānāc ca dayaikāsmin viśiṣyate ||

sarvvavedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvvayajñāś ca kheca
ra |
sarvvatīrthābhiṣekāś ca yat kuryyā prāṇināṃ dayā ||
vāgmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

dayādarśi
tapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |
gachatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgratāaḥ svapato pi vā |

yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśo
r iva ceṣṭitaṃ ||
jaṅgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |
ātmavat parirakṣanti te yānti parasāṃgatiṃ ||

prā
ṇinaṃ vadhyamānan tu yaḥ śakruḥ samiukṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃm iti prāhur maharṣayaḥ ||

rājyaṃ śivir ahaṃ samyak
prayacchāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmayase hy anyat_ varjayitvā kapotakaṃ ||

yadi rājan kapote te sudṛḍhā prī¦
tir īdṛśī |
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayaccha me ||

anugraham idaṃ manye yan māṃsenābhibhāṣa
se |
etat te haṃ prayacchāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad icchasi ||
yad apriyaṃ tsujanaś cirād vadati vā na vā |

mama nu priyam eva tat kasmā
d abhihitāṃ cirāt ||
adhruvena śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||
yadi hy upakārāya deho 'yaṃ nopayujyate |
tataḥ kim upakāro 'sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā ||

nātiri
ktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara |
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayaccha tulayā bhṛśaṃ ||

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi ya
n māṃsenābhiyācase |
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tat kariṣye vihaṅgama ||

evam uktvā svamāṃsoni sa
mutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭam tulayā māṃsaṃ kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||

tyaktvatmasukhabhogecchāṃ sarvvasatvasukhaiṣiṇa
ḥ |
bhavanti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityadukhitāḥ ||
priye mārnas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate |

puna śotkṛtya māṃ
sāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ ||
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |

tataḥ prakṣīṇaṃ māso 'sau cāruro
ha tulāṃ svayaṃ ||
paraduḥkhātulā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nāpekṣante mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api ||

atha
tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe |
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca ||

tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmarājñe dhatiṃ
parāṃ |
śatruḥ svasuḥ yam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata ||
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapote havyavāhanaḥ ||

ji
jñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann ima yajñam upāgatau ||
naitat pūrvva nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyanti cāpare |

mahākārunikena ha ye tkṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ
tvayā ||
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prātir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃśayarabdheṣu na prāṇeṣu ca dehināṃ ||

parārthaikāntakalyā
ṇī svaśreyo 'tyantaniṣṭhurāṃ |
tvayy eva kevalaṃ rājan_ karuṇā karuṇāyate ||
svakarmapāsaiḥ sudṛḍhai baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ jagat |
tvaṃ jagadduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa ||
tathā sarvvātmanā vāpi doṣeṣu prakṛtaṃ tvayā ||

yathā caivātmanaḥ sthāne vāsanā
pi na vidyate ||
akṛtverṣyā viśiṣṭeṣu vihīnānavamanya ca |
akṛtvā sadṛśe sparddhāṃ tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||

paropakā
rajanmāno vidhātrā vihitas trayaḥ |
sajalā jaladās tvañ ca saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ ||

ātmapraṇaiḥ paraprāṇan yo naraḥ
parirakṣati |
sa yāti tat paraṃ dhāmayato nāvarttate punaḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājāan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |

svāmāṃsāṃ
ny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||
paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃbhārāḥ |

sa punar jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ¦
hi jīvati ||
kim atra citraṃ yat santaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ |
na hi svadehaśītāya jāyaṃte candanadrumāḥ ||

paropakāravyāpā
raparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā |
saṃpadan tad avāpnoti parād api hi tat paraṃ ||
paropakārekadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||
yaḥ svamāṃsāni gātraṃbhyaḥ samutkṛttani pārthiva |

eṣā te sāsvatī
kīrttir lokān anu gamiṣyati ||
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ciraṃ mahī |

sarvvalokānn atikramya brahmalokaṃ
gamiṣyasi ||
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jāgmatus tridaśālayaṃ |

rājā tvayi kratum iṣṭvā tu mumuda de
vavac ciraṃ ||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti paramaṃ padaṃ ||

vicintya rā
jā svasarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvvajanasya durlabhaṃ |

śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣa
ṇaṃ yayau ||
